- FY2025 total revenue: $402.8 billion; Google Cloud revenue: $58.7 billion → share = 14.57%【calculate】.  
- Share change: ((14.57 % − 12.35 %) / 12.35 %) × 100 = 17.99% → **≈ 18.0% increase**【calculate】.

- Alphabet segment revenue for Google Cloud FY2024 & FY2025【SQL: segment_revenue】
